title: Add structured policy references to gate findings
description:
Extend the generic gate-finding contract so findings can carry opaque qualified-policy references through parsing, persistence, schemas, and output. The field remains backward compatible and does not make the engine resolve repository-specific policy.

## Background

`GateFinding` already carries checker-defined classification and location fields. Policy traceability requires an optional string collection that is preserved exactly, defaults safely for legacy records, and stays absent from serialized output when empty.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GateFinding` exposes `references: Vec<String>` with default-empty deserialization, empty-value serialization omission, and generated JSON-schema coverage.
- [hard] REQ-02: Findings parsing preserves multiple reference strings exactly, treats a missing field as an empty vector, and retains the existing graceful-degradation behavior when a `references` array contains a non-string member.
- [hard] REQ-03: Gate-run storage round-trips populated references unchanged and loads legacy stored findings without the field as an empty vector.
- [hard] REQ-04: Gate-status structured JSON and human inspection paths expose populated references unchanged, while empty references add no compatibility noise.
- [hard] REQ-05: The widest stored-record sample and `docs/reference/storage-records.md` document the optional references field and remain mechanically fresh.
- [hard] REQ-06: Core domain, storage, and output code treats reference values as opaque strings and performs no item lookup, kind validation, or repository-policy resolution.
